episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.plot: After finding a classmate’s corpse in her locker, perpetually unpopular Velma Dinkley is given an ultimatum: solve the mystery within 24 hours or face arrest for the crime. But as she reluctantly digs into the case, Velma is forced to confront the truth of her mother’s own mysterious disappearance, and fend off the advances of her best friend, Norville.

episodes.name: The Candy Man
episodes.plot: Desperate to access her missing mom’s case file, Velma strikes a deal with her former BFF Daphne – who may just have some secrets of her own. Then, while a sober Norville finds himself in with the wrong crowd, Fred claims innocence for a series of crimes.

episodes.name: Velma Kai
episodes.plot: In the wake of the murders, Principal Rogers enrolls all the female students in a self-defense class, forcing Daphne and Velma to work out their complicated relationship on the mat. Meanwhile, Norville attempts to pry the truth out of Fred the only way he knows how: cognitive behavioral therapy.

episodes.name: Velma Makes a List
episodes.plot: After yet another body turns up in town, Velma volunteers to rank Crystal Cove High’s hottest girls to help determine the next victim. While trying to figure out what traits Velma finds attractive, Norville is pulled into a mystery tied to the history of the town – and Daphne’s own dark past.

episodes.name: Marching Band Sleepover
episodes.plot: When Crystal Cove instates a nightly curfew, Velma is forced to spend the night with band geeks. But after taking advantage of Norville’s good will (again), Velma finds herself stuck chasing clues with a newly woke Fred. At work on her own mystery, Daphne discovers a shocking connection to Crystal Cove’s criminal underground.

episodes.name: The Sins of the Fathers and Some of the Mothers
episodes.plot: After realizing the only way to stop her hallucinations is to resolve her daddy issues, Velma sets out to spend time with Aman – and convince him of the truth behind his wife’s disappearance. Meanwhile, Norville takes the bad boy lifestyle for a spin, Daphne spends quality time with the Crystal Cove Gang, and Fred fights his father’s antifeminist ways.

episodes.name: Fog Fest
episodes.plot: With the Crystal Cove Fog Festival fast approaching, Velma chases clues related to the serial killer, ignoring Daphne and dashing her chances at a date to the dance in the process. Later, Norville and Fred vie for the Fog King crown, Daphne finds herself inexplicably attracted to a mysterious new kid, and Velma revels in her newfound abilities after masquerading as a man.

episodes.name: A Velma in the Woods
episodes.plot: After Velma and Daphne find themselves trapped in a cave below Mount Crystal, a series of flashbacks determine who’s responsible for their imminent demise – and where their friendship stands. Stuck in the serial killer’s underground lair, Fred proves that he really does love women for their brains, while Norville and Gigi work through their relationship problems above ground.

episodes.name: A Family (Wo)man
episodes.plot: Given 72 hours to uncover the serial killer’s identity, Velma is forced to live a lie – including raising a baby with an increasingly frustrated Norville. Shunned by the Brains, Fred and Daphne face their newfound unpopularity together… until they hatch a plan to claw their way back to the top.

episodes.name: The Brains of the Operation
episodes.plot: Despite the alleged murderer’s confession, Velma continues to work the case – and uncovers a shocking clue from her own past. Meanwhile, Daphne starts her internship with Jones Gentleman’s’ Accessories, Fred channels his rage into questionable art, and Norville makes good on his promise to get as far away from Velma as possible.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Teen Romance
episodes.plot: After Diya forbids her from solving mysteries, Velma finds herself secretly tackling another case. Meanwhile, Daphne welcomes a new roommate, Norville grapples with guilt, and Fred explores a career as Crystal Cove’s resident supernatural sleuth.

episodes.name: Creaky Friday
episodes.plot: When another victim goes missing, Velma clashes with Fred over whether the crimes plaguing Crystal Cove are of this Earth… or if answers to life’s mysteries lie in the great beyond. Later, Daphne and Amber make a grisly discovery, and Norville questions the Brains.

episodes.name: When Velma Met Money
episodes.plot: After discovering their parents’ new relationship, Velma resists the urge to cash in. As the science fair approaches, Norville works to get rid of his haunting hallucinations once and for all.

episodes.name: Seancé
episodes.plot: While stuck in Saturday detention, Amber leads Velma and her friends through a séance in hopes of summoning the ghost of a dangerous adversary. Later, a skeptical Velma does her best to dispel Daphne of her new age beliefs.

episodes.name: Burning Woman
episodes.plot: After taking to social media, Velma comes under fire for starting a scathing rumor about Amber. While Norville investigates a suspicious pseudonym at the asylum, Daphne seeks understanding through an out-of-body experience.

episodes.name: Private Velmjamin
episodes.plot: During their school’s lackluster career fair, Velma begins to doubt her dream of becoming a detective, as Norville works to help the Brains cross some items off their bucket list. Later, Fred flirts with a mysterious new suitor while helping Velma search for clues.

episodes.name: Female Utopia
episodes.plot: In the wake of yet another killing, the women of Crystal Cove are relegated to the mines. As Velma struggles to keep Sophie and Diya apart below ground, Norville discovers the truth behind his hallucinations, and Daphne faces her worst enemy: her own conscience.

episodes.name: Aman Hunt
episodes.plot: Facing a lengthy and drama-filled bus ride, Velma vows to take Daphne with the power of gossip. Later, an unlikely source provides crucial evidence that ties the killer to a clandestine military operation.

episodes.name: The Real Villain
episodes.plot: After finding herself lost in the woods, Velma meets a frightening new friend – who might hold the key to solving the murders. Meanwhile, Fred finally stands up for himself, and Diya and Aman’s respective relationships each take a serious turn.

episodes.name: Til Death
episodes.plot: When the serial killer threatens her family, Velma hatches a plan to stop the treacherous masked villain and their accomplice. Later, one of Crystal Cove’s infamous meddling kids must make the ultimate sacrifice.
